contract.task_clause:
The crowding-out effect from government borrowing is best described as
Option A: the rightward shift in AD in response to the decreasing interest rates from contractionary fiscal policy.
Option B: the leftward shift in AD in response to the rising interest rates from expansionary fiscal policy.
Option C: the effect of the President increasing the money supply which decreases real interest rates and increases AD.
Option D: the effect on the economy of hearing the chairperson of the central bank say that he or she believes that the economy is in a recession.
